svg.title: T113-S3: twelve all-pin fanout fixtures
svg.desc: The 128-lead QFP and its exposed ground pad stay fixed. 106 independent external terminals move to each side and offset. Twenty supply pins and both ground pads drop to five separate plane layers. Pin 106 is NC. Dashed squares show SoC breakout boundaries. No solved routes are shown.
svg.text: 106 external connections · 22 plane drops · 12 directional placements
Placement overview · dashed line = SoC breakout boundary · routes not shown
